attacks.name: Triage
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
If this attack would deal more than 1 |!damage|, it deals 1 |!damage| instead.

|!hit| |*Medic|: After this attack is resolved, choose up to 1 other allied character within |!range| 3. Remove 1 special condition from the chosen character or remove 1 |!damage| for each |!hit| in the attack roll from the chosen character.

attacks.name: Sonic Barrage
steps: |!wild| |*Stun|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Life Support Systems
superPowers.body: This character immediately makes a Shake action.

superPowers.name: Medevac
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately Advances |!movement_large|. Then this character may choose another allied character within |!range| 2 that has an Activated token. If it does, Place the chosen character within |!range| 1 of this character. Then this character may remove up to 2 |!damage| or 1 special condition from the chosen character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Sonic Force Fields
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 3 is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or would make a dodge roll, this character may use this superpower. This character adds 2 dice to the defense or dodge roll.

superPowers.name: Rescue Armor
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.|\|Additionally, when this character removes 1 or more |!damage| or special conditions from another allied character, after the effect is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
